title: A courier calls about a fee

open.line: Hi there, it's SwiftParcel Delivery. We tried to deliver your parcel today, but there's an unpaid fee of one pound forty-five. I can sort it out on this call. Is now a good time?

identity.line: It's SwiftParcel, the courier for your online order. You'll have had a text from us earlier. It's just the small fee, then it's on the van tomorrow.

card.line: Lovely. Can I take the long number on the front of your card, please?

card_details.line: Go ahead with the sixteen digits whenever you're ready, then the expiry date and the three numbers on the back.

pressure.line: If it's not paid in the next hour, the parcel goes back to the sender and you'll lose it. It's only one pound forty-five.

code.line: Thanks. Last thing: your bank has sent you a code to approve the payment. Just read that out for me.

end_scammed.line: Perfect, that's gone through. Thanks for your time.

truth.line: This is a Hookline practice call, not a real one. Well done for checking. That's exactly the right thing to do.
